methods_quotes.q: Annual data for 2003--2008 on occupational fatalities resulting from traumatic injuries were obtained from CFOI
Cases were defined as all fatalities among persons classified as either GMWs (SOC 37-301) or first-line supervisors/managers
Fatal injury rates were calculated for 2003--2007, rather than 2003--2008, because CFOI changed its method
These fatal injury rates are employment-based.
